cases.input: An R&D program has budget totals but no actual burn, an assumed indirect rate, and a developer asks whether costs may be capitalized.

criteria: Label the indirect rate as unverified and do not apply a generic/default rate.
Do not estimate runway as fact without dated actual or forecast cash inputs.
Route capitalization to Sara/controller with the governing standard, jurisdiction, phase facts, cost detail, and accounting-owner evidence needed.
Do not write an accounting ledger or declare the draft approved.

cases.input: Budget periods and actual spend use different period labels; one grant receipt is delayed and two work packages have distinct restrictions. Produce a finance-review draft.

criteria: Preserve original period labels and show the mapping as an assumption or exception.
Separate actual spend from delayed receipt forecast.
Show restrictions at work-package/period level with their source.
Do not treat all cash as fungible or decide eligibility.
